existingAnnotation.text: Under a narrow definition of democracy, rulers are elected through competitive elections, while broader definitions also link democracy to guarantees of civil liberties and human rights.
existingAnnotation.translation: 按照民主的狭义定义，统治者通过竞争性选举产生；而更广义的定义还将民主与公民自由及人权的保障联系起来。
existingAnnotation.analysis: 句首 Under a narrow definition 是范围状语。rulers are elected 使用被动语态。while 连接两个分句，在这里表示对比；link A to B 表示“把 A 与 B 联系起来”。
